name: Username sign-in screen
description: Verifies the public entry uses Tech Check by Cameras Onsite branding and does not request an email address.
steps: Confirm the heading says Tech Check by Cameras Onsite
Confirm Username and Password fields are visible
expected: The sign-in screen uses Cameras Onsite branding, shows username and password fields, and does not show an email field.

name: Reject invalid credentials
description: Verifies incorrect credentials do not expose technician workflow data.
expected: A visible Username or password is incorrect message appears and the IT, Service Tech, and Owner work areas remain hidden.

name: Mobile technician login
description: Verifies the technician login remains usable on a phone-sized viewport after standalone Home Screen support is enabled.
steps: Confirm Password and Sign In are visible
expected: The sign-in form is readable and usable without horizontal scrolling, with the app configured for standalone Home Screen launch.
